title: Siege of Masbate
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Masbate", at revision 1370743331, opens: "The siege of Masbate was fought on 19 August 1898, on Masbate Island as a part of the Philippine Revolution." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q7510230, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1898 siege". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
